question_en: List all persons who died recently
question_fr: Liste toutes les personnes décédées récemment
translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.ID_PERSON FROM T_WC_T2S_PERSON p WHERE p.DEATH_YEAR IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.DEATH_YEAR DESC, p.DEATH_MONTH DESC, p.DEATH_DAY DESC LIMIT 8
